notes: Circuit lengths are normalized to published lap lengths. Elevation charts are digitized and aligned to named sections, with monotone interpolation. Pit lanes, buildings and roadside scenery are modeled approximations, not surveyed or laser-scanned replicas. Widths retain the approved Mercedes preview profiles and 1.2 scale. All world meshes are built before play, compressed for delivery and fully decompressed before the car loads. Brand circuits and Track 1.0 files are preserved.
